sections.shortTitle: Punjab Pre-Emption Removal of Doubts Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 1972
ORDINANCE XI
OF 1972
PUNJAB PRE‑EMPTION
(REMOVAL OF DOUBTS) ORDINANCE, 1972
1. Short
title and commencement-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Pre‑emotion
(Removal of Doubts) Ordinance, 1972.
(2) It shall
come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the 7th
January 1972.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Pre-Emption Removal of Doubts Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Removal of doubts

ORDINANCE XI OF 1972
ORDINANCE XI
OF 1972
PUNJAB PRE‑EMPTION
(REMOVAL OF DOUBTS) ORDINANCE, 1972
2. Removal of
doubts.‑Notwithstanding anything contained !n the Punjab Pre‑emotion
Act, 1913 or any other law, or Notification No. 6416‑71/ 3316‑LRIII,
dated the 23rd November 1971, issued by the Board of Revenue, Punjab, and
published in the Punjab Gazette of 7th January 1972 (hereinafter referred to as
the notification), or any decree, judgment or order of any Court, or any
proceeding pending before any Court, the notification shall not apply to any
sale of agricultural land or other immovable property unless‑
(a) such sale
is in respect of the agricultural land or other immovable property described in
the Schedule to this Ordinance and is in favour of a person displaced from Mianwali
District by the construction of Chashma Barrage ; and
(b) it is
certified by the Commissioner of Sargodha Division that such person has been so
affected by the construction of the said Barrage.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Pre-Emption Removal of Doubts Ordinance 1972
sections.description:
Restoration and fresh disposal of suits etc.

ORDINANCE XI OF 1972
ORDINANCE XI
OF 1972
PUNJAB PRE‑EMPTION
(REMOVAL OF DOUBTS) ORDINANCE, 1972
3.
Restoration and fresh disposal of suits etc.‑All suits, appeals and other
proceedings decided after the issuance of :the notification on the basis of any
interpretation of the notification inconsistent with the provisions of this
Ordinance shall stand restored and be decided afresh.
